comparison.objective: Install a rack rail; record mounts a grinding wheel safely on a spindle.
comparison.physical_skill: Separated-post prong alignment and telescoping rail support versus wheel inspection, ordered coaxial assembly, spindle locking, and nut tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Four spring engagements at one rack unit plus prescribed screws versus the good wheel and mounting stack correctly seated/tightened with hands withdrawn.
comparison.reason: Both include fastening, but their alignment topology, sequence, hazards, and endpoint checks are materially different.
